description: This file defines the DashboardUtilsService class, providing utility methods for managing dashboard configurations, layouts, widgets, and breakpoints in an Angular application for Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DashboardUtilsService
classes.description: A service providing utility functions for managing dashboard configurations, layouts, widgets, breakpoints, and related operations in an Angular application.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateDashboard
methods.description: Validates and updates the dashboard configuration, including widgets, states, entity aliases, filters, and settings.

methods.name: createSingleWidgetDashboard
methods.description: Creates a dashboard containing a single specified widget.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateWidget
methods.description: Validates and updates a widget's configuration, type, and related properties.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateWidgetTypeFqn
methods.description: Ensures the widget's full type name is valid, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateWidgetConfig
methods.description: Validates and updates a widget's configuration based on its type.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateWidgetConfigWithModelDefinition
methods.description: Validates and updates widget configuration using a widget model definition.

methods.name: removeTimewindowConfigIfUnused
methods.description: Removes timewindow-related configuration if it is unused.

methods.name: prepareWidgetForSaving
methods.description: Prepares a widget for saving by cleaning up unused properties.

methods.name: prepareWidgetForScadaLayout
methods.description: Adjusts widget configuration for SCADA layout, setting visual properties accordingly.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateDatasources
methods.description: Validates and updates datasources in widget configurations.

methods.name: getWidgetDatasources
methods.description: Retrieves datasources for a widget, possibly using model definitions.

methods.name: createDefaultLayoutData
methods.description: Creates a default dashboard layout object.

methods.name: createDefaultGridSettings
methods.description: Creates default grid settings for layouts.

methods.name: createDefaultLayouts
methods.description: Creates default layouts for dashboard states.

methods.name: createDefaultState
methods.description: Creates a default dashboard state with specified name and root flag.

methods.name: createSingleEntityFilter
methods.description: Creates an entity filter for a single entity ID.

methods.name: widgetConfigFromWidgetType
methods.description: Generates widget configuration from a widget type descriptor.

methods.name: convertDatasourcesFromWidgetType
methods.description: Converts datasources based on widget type descriptor.

methods.name: convertDatasourceFromWidgetType
methods.description: Converts a datasource based on widget type descriptor.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateState
methods.description: Validates and updates a dashboard state.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateLayout
methods.description: Validates and updates a dashboard layout.

methods.name: setLayouts
methods.description: Sets new layouts for a dashboard state and adjusts columns accordingly.

methods.name: isReferenceWidget
methods.description: Checks if a widget is referenced multiple times across dashboard states and layouts.

methods.name: getRootStateId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the root dashboard state.

methods.name: getStateLayoutsData
methods.description: Retrieves layout data for a specific dashboard state, including breakpoints.

methods.name: getBreakpointLayoutData
methods.description: Extracts layout data for a specific breakpoint.

methods.name: getWidgetsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all widgets in a dashboard.

methods.name: isEmptyDashboard
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard has no widgets.

methods.name: addWidgetToLayout
methods.description: Adds a widget to a specified layout and position within a dashboard.

methods.name: widgetPossiblePosition
methods.description: Finds a possible position for a widget within a layout avoiding collisions.

methods.name: hasWidgetCollision
methods.description: Checks if a widget overlaps with others in a layout.

methods.name: removeWidgetFromLayout
methods.description: Removes a widget from a layout.

methods.name: isSingleLayoutDashboard
methods.description: Determines if a dashboard has only one state and one layout.

methods.name: updateLayoutSettings
methods.description: Updates layout grid settings and adjusts widget positions to prevent overlaps.

methods.name: moveWidgets
methods.description: Moves all widgets in a layout by specified column and row offsets.

methods.name: removeUnusedWidgets
methods.description: Removes widgets that are not referenced in any layout.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateEntityAliases
methods.description: Validates and updates entity aliases in dashboard configuration.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateDeviceAlias
methods.description: Validates and updates a device alias.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateEntityAlias
methods.description: Validates and updates an entity alias.

methods.name: validateAndUpdateEntityAliasSingleTypeFilters
methods.description: Validates and updates single-type filters within an entity alias.

methods.name: validateAliasId
methods.description: Validates or generates a new alias ID, updating associated datasources and target devices.

methods.name: replaceReferenceWithWidgetCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a widget, optionally removing the original, and inserts it into a specified layout position.

methods.name: getDashboardLayoutConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the layout configuration for a specific breakpoint.

methods.name: getOriginalColumns
methods.description: Calculates the original number of columns for a layout based on source dashboard state.

methods.name: getOriginalSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size and properties of a widget in a specific layout.

methods.name: loadSystemBreakpoints
methods.description: Loads system breakpoint information based on media query constants.

methods.name: getListBreakpoint
methods.description: Returns a list of all breakpoints including default.

methods.name: getBreakpoints
methods.description: Returns an array of breakpoint size values.

methods.name: getBreakpointInfoByValue
methods.description: Finds breakpoint info by its size value.

methods.name: getBreakpointInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves breakpoint info by ID.

methods.name: getBreakpointName
methods.description: Returns the translated name of a breakpoint.

methods.name: getBreakpointIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with a breakpoint.

methods.name: getBreakpointSizeDescription
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a breakpoint's size range.

methods.name: updatedLayoutForBreakpoint
methods.description: Updates layout context for a specific breakpoint, reloading controls if necessary.
